description: Use scenarioId from scenario.list or resources/connections, not both. Returns id for simulation.step. Check for a committed create before retrying a timeout. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.create/core

autoscalingConfig.description: Complete policy; explicit top-level bounds and CPU targets win. Unknown fields reject.

ecsCpuTargetTracking.description: Requires AWS Fargate. Enables the ECS timing fields.

appDbPoolSize.description: Owned typical: pool size 250 on each app.

capacityProvisioning.description: Declare seconds/step, deadlines, pool controller/version, placement and bounds, initial nodes and retry/startup. Guide has strict nested shapes.

databaseConnectionModel.description: On the database; held-pools binds retained consumer pools.

databaseConsumers.description: Logical consumers; select held-pools on the target database. managedPoolId needs explicit mode.

gpuReadiness.description: EKS: initialReadyNodes required. Phase timings are seconds. concurrent-calls capacity requires meanCallDurationSeconds.

maxConnections.description: Fixed concurrent DB connection budget; Aurora Serverless defaults from maximum configured ACU.

nodePools.description: EKS GPU pools: id/name, size, nodeCount/minNodes/maxNodes; each has gpuReadiness as above.

preemptible.description: Legacy GCP preemptible purchase identity; no probabilistic interruption schedule.

pricingModel.description: Spot needs a dated exact type/region quote.

spotPricingUnverified.description: Unresolved imported mixed purchase configuration; do not substitute an on-demand rate.

scaleInCooldownSeconds.description: Simulated seconds; requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true and AWS Fargate. Defaults to cooldownSeconds.

scaleOutCooldownSeconds.description: Simulated seconds; requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true and AWS Fargate. Defaults to cooldownSeconds.

simulationSecondsPerStep.description: Requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true and AWS Fargate. ECS cooldown clock only; default 1.
